content: For FastAPI + sqlite3: open connection with check_same_thread=False (FastAPI's sync def path operations run in a threadpool, so requests hit sqlite3 from multiple threads); set PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL for concurrent reads during a write; set a busy_timeout (e.g. 5000ms) so concurrent writers retry instead of raising 'database is locked' immediately. WAL requires a local filesystem (not NFS/network volume) -- fine for a hackathon single-process local demo. Single-writer/many-reader is SQLite's sweet spot; this app never needs concurrent writers.
